Não. O DriverSize não instala serviços,: No. DriverSize installs no services, system hooks or Explorer extensions: it only uses resources while you are scanning. Once you close it, nothing keeps running in the background.
Funciona em HD externo, pendrive e rede?: Does it work on external drives, USB sticks and networks?
Funciona. Além dos discos locais, o Driv: Yes. Besides local disks, DriverSize scans external HDDs, SSDs, USB sticks, SD cards, NAS, SAN and network shares (UNC paths).
Qual a diferença entre “Tamanho” e “Tama: What's the difference between “Size” and “Size on disk”?
“Tamanho” é a soma real dos bytes dos ar: “Size” is the actual sum of the file bytes. “Size on disk” takes the space occupied in clusters into account — so it is always equal to or larger than the logical size.
